content.value_statement: Single-cell omics analysis requires careful model choice, preprocessing, and interpretation. This skill guides scvi-tools workflows for integration, differential expression, annotation, and spatial analysis.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use scVI, scANVI, totalVI, MultiVI, PeakVI, DestVI, and related models.
Provides AnnData setup patterns for layers, batches, labels, protein matrices, and covariates.
Guides model training, latent representation extraction, normalized expression, and downstream Scanpy analysis.
Covers differential expression settings, result interpretation, effect-size thresholds, and multiple testing concepts.
Summarizes workflows for GPU use, hyperparameter tuning, reference mapping, model minification, and troubleshooting.
Documents modality-specific guidance for RNA, ATAC, CITE-seq, multiome, methylation, cytometry, and spatial data.
limitations: Does not run scvi-tools or validate results without the user's execution environment and data.
Does not replace statistical review for study design, batch structure, or biological interpretation.
Examples assume familiarity with Python, AnnData, Scanpy, and single-cell quality control.
Installation notes require users to choose compatible Python, PyTorch, and GPU dependencies.

use_cases.title: Select the right model
use_cases.description: Compare scvi-tools models for RNA, ATAC, protein, multiome, spatial, or specialized single-cell data.

use_cases.title: Plan reproducible workflows
use_cases.description: Create analysis plans for preprocessing, model setup, training, integration, visualization, and result storage.

use_cases.title: Interpret model outputs
use_cases.description: Review latent spaces, normalized expression, differential expression results, uncertainty, and model limitations.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a model
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner model selection for a known dataset type.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have [data modality] data with [batch structure] and want to [analysis goal]. Recommend a scvi-tools model and required AnnData fields.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a scvi-tools workflow for [dataset description]. Include preprocessing, setup fields, model training, outputs, and quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Review differential expression
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of analysis choices and interpretation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my differential expression plan for [groups], [cell types], and [batches]. Explain mode, delta, FDR target, and interpretation risks.

prompt_templates.title: Design multimodal integration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for complex multi-omic or spatial studies.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare totalVI, MultiVI, MrVI, and spatial options for [study design]. Recommend a modeling strategy, validation checks, and reporting plan.

output_examples.input: A user asks which scvi-tools model fits paired RNA and protein CITE-seq data.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends totalVI, explains required RNA and protein fields, and outlines training, latent extraction, and differential analysis steps.

output_examples.input: A user needs help analyzing imbalanced cell groups for differential expression.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests change mode, effect-size thresholds, adequate posterior samples, and cautious interpretation of small groups.

output_examples.input: A user wants to map a query dataset to a reference atlas.
output_examples.output: The skill describes scArches-style transfer learning, matching setup fields, fine-tuning options, and label transfer checks.

best_practices: Keep raw counts in a dedicated AnnData layer before normalization or feature selection.
Register known technical covariates, batches, and labels before creating each model.
Save trained models and annotated AnnData outputs with clear version and dataset metadata.
anti_patterns: Training on log-normalized values when a model expects raw counts.
Ignoring known donor, batch, or chemistry effects during setup.
Using differential expression rankings without reviewing effect sizes, uncertainty, and group sizes.

faq.question: Does this skill execute analysis code?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples that users run in their own Python environment.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is prepared for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Can it help choose a scvi-tools model?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares models by modality, inputs, outputs, and common analysis goals.

faq.question: Does it cover GPU training?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for GPU acceleration, memory handling, and training configuration.

faq.question: Is it only for scRNA-seq?
faq.answer: No. It also covers ATAC-seq, CITE-seq, multiome, spatial, methylation, cytometry, and other modalities.

faq.question: Can it interpret statistical results?
faq.answer: It explains common output fields and interpretation risks, but final biological conclusions require expert review.
